COPY api/ /app copies the contents of api/ → /app/uv.lock ✓ /app/pyproject.toml ✓. And the path dependencies are resolved inside the context: '../data_structures' from /app → /data_structures!! But it does: it needs to build/install path dependencies (metadata) → Distribution not found. Hmm! But wait: did the original addon's uv.lock contain data-structures as directory sources? Yes (from the pyproject sources). So the test-deps stage in the original would also fail... unless the private index provided those packages as wheels (in which case the original lock would be registry sources, not directories!).

Hmm. In the original build (private registry), the uv.lock for these addons was probably generated with demospipes-data-structures from the private index (registry source), because `uv sync` with credentials... no — the sources in pyproject pin to path, so the lock would be directory sources. To make the test-deps stage work, the easiest is: also copy the dependency directories to the root of the context so that /data_structures exists? No — /app is WORKDIR; '../data_structures' from /app = /data_structures (container root). I could add `COPY data_structures/ /data_structures/` — hacky.

Better: change the test-deps path dependencies to the root of the context? The uv.lock directory source paths are relative to the location of pyproject (api/). Then the lock path 'data_structures' (relative to api/) works for re-lock, but for the container's /app... /app/data_structures exists ✓.

So: for bmds addons, rewrite the path dependencies in api/pyproject and executors/pyproject to point to the sibling directories staged at $d root ('../data-structures', '../data_structures') — for the relock that's correct — then the test-deps COPY api/ /app breaks it. Instead, rewrite to the 'data-structures'/'data_structures' inside api/ itself: copy the dependency directories into $d/api/ and $d/executors/ (so they're included in COPY api/ /app), and rewrite the sources to 'data-structures'/'data_structures' (inside the package directory). The relock in $d/api works; the container's /app/data-structures exists ✓. The builder stage copies ./api/pyproject.toml + ./api/<pkgdir> → pip wheel . with --find-links local-wheels (the fix_pipwheel output) — pip ignores uv sources; the dependencies resolve from the local-wheels wheels ✓.

And local-wheels: build from $d/data-structures + $d/data_structures (already staged at root) ✓.

Also, the final stage's `pip install --find-links=. ./*.whl` installs the addon wheel + its dependencies from the same directory ✓ (data-structures wheels are in /wheels ✓).
